findings.title: URL origin not validated before outbound request
findings.body: request builds a URL from pathOrUrl without validating that the origin matches the configured SWAPI base URL. This allows SSRF if an attacker provides a malicious URL via tool parameters. Validate the origin before constructing the outbound request.

findings.title: idFromUrl regex does not validate resource path segment
findings.body: idFromUrl extracts the numeric id from a SWAPI URL but does not validate that the path segment matches the expected resource. This can lead to misattribution when the same numeric id exists across different resources. Validate the resource segment before extracting the id.

findings.title: Inconsistent parameter naming in get_starship
findings.body: The tool uses id as the parameter name, while other tools in the codebase use idOrUrl. Renaming to idOrUrl improves consistency with the client API and avoids confusion about the accepted input types.
findings.suggestion: id: z.union([z.number().int().positive(), z.string()]).describe("Starship resource ID or full SWAPI starship URL"),

findings.title: Missing test for error branch in searchPeople
findings.body: The new searchPeople method lacks a test that covers its error branch. Add a test that stubs fetch to return a non-2xx response and asserts that the client propagates an ApiError.

findings.title: Missing test for error branch in get_film
findings.body: The new get_film tool lacks a test that covers its error branch. Add a test that calls the tool with an unknown film_id and asserts that the result is an error with isError=true and a clear message.

findings.title: Unexpected error rethrow in toErrorResult
findings.body: toErrorResult rethrows non-ApiError errors, which will crash the MCP server. Instead, map unknown errors to a structured tool error so the agent receives a predictable response.

findings.title: Unhandled error in get_film tool
findings.body: get_film calls client.getFilm and requireFilmByEpisode without a surrounding try/catch, so an ApiError or network error will propagate as an unhandled exception and crash the MCP server.

findings.title: Missing validation for exactly one identifier
findings.body: The tool accepts both film_id and episode_id without enforcing that exactly one is provided. Use && instead of === to require exactly one.
